description: This file defines a configuration settings data class for the Hand Detection API, including functions to load environment variables and return a settings object. It primarily handles environment variable reading, default values, and exposes a public function for other modules to access configuration.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Immutable dataclass representing configuration settings for the API, loaded from environment variables.

methods.name: bool _get_env_bool(name: str, default: bool)
methods.description: Helper to interpret environment variable strings as boolean values.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Returns a Settings instance populated from environment variables.
